rain.plot.player.tell.main_plot.c_4.text: In the beginning of chaos, yin and yang were first divided, and primal energy permeated.
Beyond the void, stars were yet unplaced; within the underworld, water and fire lay hidden.
In the void, a faint light born is me. Before distinguishing dawn from dusk, first split the primordial chaos.
Before distinguishing dawn from dusk, first split the primordial chaos.
The turbid descends, the clear ascends, blending and churning; galaxies spin forth from the palm.
Looking back, the silent primeval passes; the azure lotus falls deep into shadow.
At the glance back, lies the path of creation, traces of the fire of tribulation.
